newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Airlines October load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Airlines October load factor up.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Wednesday its October passenger load factor rose 3.49 points to 52.92 percent from 49.43 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles gained 88.6 percent to 46.9 million from 24.8 million, and available seat miles increased 76.1 percent to 88.5 million from 50.3 million.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor was 62.50 percent, up 10.23 points from 52.27 percent. Revenue passenger miles rose 142.5 percent to 570.8 million and available seat miles jumped 101.1 percent to 913.3 million.
